headline: On last trading day, Sensex crashed 1,484 points; markets closed today for Guru Nanak Jayanti.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.

why: NSE and BSE are closed today, 24 November 2026, for the Guru Nanak Jayanti holiday.
Profit booking in the last session led to a sharp 1.8% decline in Indian markets.
Weak global market cues pressured domestic indices during Monday's trading session.
The Sensex plummeted 1,484 points as selling pressure intensified before the holiday.
whatHappening: Investors lost over Rs 6 lakh crore as the Sensex fell more than 1,400 points on Monday.
Mumbai was named among the top 10 real estate investment destinations in the Asia-Pacific region.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's net worth rose $33 billion after a Wall Street recovery.
The Nifty fell below the 25,350 level during the last trading session.
summary: Indian markets are closed today for Guru Nanak Jayanti following a sharp 1.8% decline in the previous session. On Monday, the Sensex crashed 1,484 points and the Nifty fell below 25,350, wiping out Rs 6 lakh crore in investor wealth. The downturn was driven by profit booking and weak global cues, ending a recent record-breaking rally.
